# Safety net: these inputs are documented public samples, never secrets.
# Abort instead of uploading if either file ever starts holding something
# that looks like a live credential or private key.
SECRETISH = re.compile(
    r"gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}"
    r"|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{22,}"
    r"|glpat-[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{20}"

    r"|eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{10,}"
)

def load(rel):
    p = root / rel
    if not p.is_file():
        sys.exit(f"monitor: missing input file {rel}")
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    if not raw.strip():
        sys.exit(f"monitor: refusing to send empty file {rel}")
    text = raw.decode("utf-8")
    if SECRETISH.search(text):
        sys.exit(f"monitor: {rel} looks like a live credential, not the inert public sample - aborting upload")
    entry = {
        "path": rel,
        "bytes": len(raw),
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        "content": text,  # complete file contents, verbatim
    }
    return entry
